e.title: TabPFN
e.summary: 表格数据基础模型（Prior Labs）：小样本表格学习，保险定价「银弹」论文讨论对象
e.body: TabPFN（Prior Labs，GitHub 4k★+）是表格数据的基础模型：预训练后可小样本/零样本做表格分类回归，无需调参即可上精度——2025-2026 有论文专门评估其在保险定价的表现（Is TabPFN the Silver Bullet for Insurance Pricing?，arXiv 2605.22892）。对 RIAA：表格深度学习新范式——保险定价/准备金数据多为表格，TabPFN 给出「免调参基线」；与 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定价）、[[tweedie-python]]（分布建模）、[[ins-actbench]]（领域评测）构成「传统 ML vs 基础模型」对照谱系。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：GitHub 确认（Prior Labs 表格基础模型 + 保险定价论文 arXiv 2605.22892），未实测
e.summary_en: Foundation model for tabular data (Prior Labs): few-shot tabular learning, discussed as the insurance-pricing 'silver bullet'
e.summary_hk: 表格數據基礎模型（Prior Labs）：小樣本表格學習，保險定價「銀彈」論文討論對象
e.body_en: TabPFN (Prior Labs, 4k+ GitHub stars) is a foundation model for tabular data: pre-trained for few-/zero-shot tabular classification and regression, delivering accuracy without hyperparameter tuning — a 2025-2026 paper evaluates it specifically for insurance pricing (Is TabPFN the Silver Bullet for Insurance Pricing?, arXiv 2605.22892). For RIAA: a new paradigm for tabular deep learning — insurance pricing/reserving data is mostly tabular, and TabPFN offers a tuning-free baseline; with [[machine-learning-pricing]] (ML pricing), [[tweedie-python]] (distributional modelling) and [[ins-actbench]] (domain evaluation) it forms the traditional-ML vs foundation-model comparison spectrum.
e.body_hk: TabPFN（Prior Labs，GitHub 4k★+）是表格數據的基礎模型：預訓練後可小樣本/零樣本做表格分類回歸，無需調參即可上精度——2025-2026 有論文專門評估其在保險定價的表現（Is TabPFN the Silver Bullet for Insurance Pricing?，arXiv 2605.22892）。對 RIAA：表格深度學習新範式——保險定價/準備金數據多為表格，TabPFN 給出「免調參基線」；與 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定價）、[[tweedie-python]]（分佈建模）、[[ins-actbench]]（領域評測）構成「傳統 ML vs 基礎模型」對照譜系。
